claims.label: Host Says SUV Glove Pocket Was Empty When Charlie Kirk Exited the Vehicle at UVU
claims.claim: The host says Mikey McCoy's footage of Charlie Kirk's arrival shows the rear-door pocket of the SUV as empty at the moment Kirk exited the vehicle, although black gloves were later recovered from that pocket.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-check the McCoy footage against police inventory records for the transport SUV and the official glove recovery chain of custody.

claims.label: FBI agents arrived at UVU at 12:39 PM, 16 minutes after the 12:23 PM shooting
claims.claim: Per a Kash Patel public statement played in the episode, the first FBI agents arrived at UVU with chiefs of police at 12:39 PM, 16 minutes after the 12:23 PM shooting, and secured the scene.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the 12:39 PM arrival timestamp against UVU campus entry logs, FBI case file timestamps, and Patel/Dan Bonino interview transcripts.

claims.label: Officer Bagley's body cam ran 27 min 35 sec and ended on the Losi rooftop
claims.claim: Officer Bagley testified that his body cam footage began at the Hall of Flags and ran 27 minutes 35 seconds, ending while he was still on the rooftop and before crime tape was placed.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the body cam file metadata and manufacturer battery-life specifications to verify whether 27 minutes is plausible as a battery depletion event.

claims.label: Officer Bagley could not identify the plainclothes man who went with him to the Losi rooftop
claims.claim: Officer Bagley testified at the preliminary hearing that he did not know the identity, agency, or origin of the plainclothes individual wearing a badge and carrying a handgun who accompanied him up the Losi building stairs.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference Bagley's testimony against UVU campus credentialing logs and the bystander footage in A-2227.1.

claims.label: Officer Bagley Testifies Plainclothes Man on Rooftop Had a Badge and a Handgun
claims.claim: In a preliminary-hearing clip the host plays, Officer Bagley, under questioning, confirms that the second individual who accompanied him onto the Losi rooftop appeared to have a badge and was carrying a handgun.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Bagley's badge-and-handgun description with the bystander footage to verify whether the same individual matches both Bagley's testimony and the visual identification.

claims.label: Host Says Bystander Footage at 12:47 PM Shows Officer Bagley and a Second Plainclothes Man on the Losi Rooftop
claims.claim: The host says bystander footage timestamped 12:47 PM captured Officer Bagley and a second plainclothes man (red hat, bag with badge, backpack) on the Losi Center rooftop.
claims.investigative_direction: Authenticate the bystander clip's timestamp and original camera metadata, and run the red-hat figure against UVU/USU event credentialing records.

claims.label: Red-hat man on Losi rooftop identified as Allan Robertson of USU PD
claims.claim: Per an X post by Muppet Masher, the red-hat man visible in the 12:47 PM bystander footage was identified as Allan Robertson of the Utah State University Department of Public Safety.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Robertson's identification through facial comparison, event credential records, and corroborating witness statements.

claims.label: Blue-shirt man on Losi rooftop identified as Christopher Hawk
claims.claim: Per the same Muppet Masher identification, the blue-shirt man walking near the Losi rooftop was identified as Christopher Hawk.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Hawk's presence and role through credential records and follow-up witness interviews.

claims.label: Allan Robertson joined the USU police force the summer before the Kirk shooting
claims.claim: A USU Department of Public Safety Facebook announcement, displayed in the episode, states that Allan Robertson had joined the USU police force the summer prior to the September 2025 shooting.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original Facebook post metadata (date, author) and corroborate with USU PD hiring records.

claims.label: Host Says Allan Robertson Was a US Marine Corps Marksmanship Instructor at Camp Pendleton, 2009–2014
claims.claim: The host says that, per Robertson's LinkedIn profile, he served as a marksmanship instructor for the Marines at Camp Pendleton from 2009 to 2014 and was deployed in Afghanistan and humanitarian work in Japan.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull archived versions of the LinkedIn profile and cross-check against Marine Corps service records.

claims.label: Host Says Brady List Website Has an Entry for Allan E. Robertson
claims.claim: The host says the Brady List website contains an entry for Allan E. Robertson associated with San Bernardino Police Department.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the underlying Brady disclosure record via CPRA / public records request to San Bernardino PD, or via prosecutorial discovery channels.

claims.label: Host Says Brady List Website Lists San Bernardino PD as Not in Compliance with Brady Disclosure Obligations
claims.claim: The host says the Brady List website notes that San Bernardino PD is not in compliance with its Brady disclosure obligations, leaving offense details for officers (including Robertson) undisclosed.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the non-compliance notation through Brady List's own documentation and California's Commission on Peace Officer Standards and Training (POST) records.

claims.label: US Central Command officer emailed a request for creative and unconventional ideas to pressure Iran
claims.claim: A CNN report described an email from a senior US Central Command intelligence-branch officer, sent on a Wednesday to a broad group of military analysts, soliciting new creative and unconventional ideas for pressuring Iran.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original CNN article and any underlying Pentagon / CENTCOM releases; identify the originating office and the recipient distribution list.

claims.label: Erica Kirk stated she does not know what Charlie Kirk would think about war with Iran
claims.claim: In a media clip played during the episode, Erica Kirk stated that her husband is not here to say whether or not the US should be at war with Iran, and that she personally does not want US boots on the ground or American kinetic involvement.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original media appearance (outlet, date, full context) and confirm the quote is unedited.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk called war with Iran "pathologically insane" in archived footage
claims.claim: In archived Charlie Kirk video clips the host plays, Kirk describes bombing Iranian nuclear facilities and going to war with Iran as "pathologically insane."
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the original source videos (date, outlet, full clip) to confirm context and that the clips are unedited.

claims.label: Charlie Kirk stated "This is Israel's war" in archived footage
claims.claim: An archived Charlie Kirk clip lists prior US military interventions and characterizes US confrontation with Iran as "Israel's war."
claims.investigative_direction: Source the original archived segment to verify date, venue, and full context of the statement.

claims.label: Frank Turek claims he "yanked and banked" while the group arrived at the hospital parking lot
claims.claim: In a Frank Turek interview clip, Turk uses the phrase "yanking and banking" to describe what the group was doing as they pulled into the hospital parking lot with Kirk.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Frank Turek interview and clarify what "yanking and banking" refers to in context (procedure vs. colloquial expression).

claims.label: Nissi's analysis asserts Officer Bagley's testimony omits key interactions with the red-hat man
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays, YouTuber Nissi asserts that Officer Bagley failed to mention (a) the red-hat man alerting him to the holster, (b) any pre-rooftop conversation with the red-hat man, and (c) the suspicious timing of his body cam stopping at a convenient moment.
claims.investigative_direction: Re-listen to Bagley's preliminary-hearing testimony in full and cross-check against UVU campus surveillance for any pre-rooftop interaction.

claims.label: Host Says TPUSA Has Reversed Charlie's Positions
claims.claim: The host says Turning Point USA has reversed course on positions Charlie Kirk held throughout his career, and frames this as institutional 'pregnancy brain'.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare TPUSA's current public statements with Kirk's dated on-air statements to identify which positions were reversed.
claims.transcript_snippet: Turning Point USA, they've been experiencing a lot of pregnancy brain when it comes to the positions that Charlie held throughout his entire career, which they've just reversed course on.

claims.label: Host Says Gloves Were Left in Left Rear Door of Transport SUV
claims.claim: The host says she broke the story two weeks earlier that black gloves were left in the left rear door of the SUV that transported Charlie to the hospital, shown side by side with the team's recreation, and that the team speculated they were leather or black nitrile.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original photograph of the door compartment and the SUV's evidence inventory to establish what the object is.
claims.transcript_snippet: Do not forget that in the SUV that transported Charlie to the hospital, there were black gloves that were left in the left side door right in the back.

claims.label: Host Says Sleuth Tip Revealed McCoy Recorded Kirk's Final Weeks
claims.claim: The host says a sleuth emailed a tip that Mikey McCoy had been recording Charlie's last moments, including in the weeks leading up to the shooting, and that his footage of Kirk exiting the car is the basis for the empty-pocket finding.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain McCoy's full recording set for the week of September 10 and its metadata to establish provenance and filming dates.
claims.transcript_snippet: turns out that the amazing Mikey McCoy who was suddenly recording Charlie's last moments in the weeks leading up as well.

claims.label: Host Says Harpole Was Not Seated on the Glove-Pocket Side
claims.claim: The host says Brian Harpole was not sitting on the side of the car where the gloves were found, and was already covered in blood.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish the seating chart of the SUV from the occupants' own accounts and any interior photographs.
claims.transcript_snippet: Brian was definitively not sitting on that side of the car and he was already covered in blood.

claims.label: Host Says Harpole Told of a Nurse Wiping Blood From His Face
claims.claim: The host says Harpole tells a story that a nurse wiped the blood off his face, which she uses to argue he had no reason to stop and put on gloves in the moving car.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Harpole interview where the nurse account is given and identify the nurse and hospital staff present.
claims.transcript_snippet: He tells a story about how the nurse wiped it off of his face.

claims.label: Host Recounts Harpole Saying Cutler Only Held Him in the Car
claims.claim: The host recounts that the group was told Rick Cutler did nothing but hold Brian Harpole with two hands so he would not fall out of the car, and asks whether Cutler would need gloves for that, using a diagram.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Harpole's and Cutler's own recorded accounts of who did what during the ride.
claims.transcript_snippet: And we were told that Rick Cutler didn't do nothing but hold Brian Harpole with a tattoo.

claims.label: Host Says Cutler Allegedly Stripped Down His Clothes at the Hospital
claims.claim: The host says Rick Cutler was among those who allegedly stripped off clothes at the hospital, and says Frank Turek has been open about doing so.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask hospital staff and the group to confirm who changed clothes, and obtain any hospital security video of the entrance.
claims.transcript_snippet: Now, we also told you that Rick was among those who allegedly stripped down his clothes at the hospital.

claims.label: Host Says Feds Allegedly Took Cutler's Clothes Down to Boxer Briefs
claims.claim: The host says she was told the feds were the ones who allegedly took those clothes, leaving Cutler down to his boxer briefs, which she calls 'a bit much'.
claims.investigative_direction: Request FBI evidence-receipt records for clothing taken from Cutler and others at the hospital.
claims.transcript_snippet: we uh were also told that the feds were the ones who allegedly took those clothes thereafter down to his boxer briefs allegedly.

claims.label: Host Recounts Harpole's Gurney Account in the ER
claims.claim: The host recounts Harpole's story that he grabbed a gurney, jumped on top of Charlie in the ER and began cutting his shirt while the staff looked on awaiting instructions on what drugs to administer, and says the public does not buy it.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain ER staff statements and the hospital's trauma-bay record for who treated Kirk on arrival.
claims.transcript_snippet: Particularly the portion where Brian Harpole grabs a gurnie, jumps on top of Charlie in the ER, and begins cutting his shirt while the staff looks on for further instructions

claims.label: Host Says Harpole Said He Was Doing the Medical in Shawn Ryan Interview
claims.claim: The host says that in the Shawn Ryan interview Harpole said 'We're doing the medical', and argues from that interview that Harpole was not the one in charge.
claims.investigative_direction: Pull the Shawn Ryan interview and transcribe Harpole's exact words about the medical response.
claims.transcript_snippet: Even when he describes things in that Shawn Ryan interview, he's like, "We're doing the medical.

claims.label: Host Says Screwdriver Carries Lance Twiggs's DNA Alongside Tyler Robinson's
claims.claim: The host says the screwdriver found on the rooftop has Lance Twiggs's DNA alongside Tyler Robinson's DNA.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the FBI DNA report on the screwdriver (listed in sealed exhibits) for the contributor profiles.
claims.transcript_snippet: We do know it has Lance Twiggs's DNA alongside Tyler Robinson's DNA.

claims.label: Host Says It Is Unknown Whether the Screwdriver Works for the Gun
claims.claim: The host says it is still not known whether the screwdriver even works for that particular gun.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the rifle's disassembly specifications and the exhibit photographs of the screwdriver and screw heads.
claims.transcript_snippet: we still don't know um if that screwdriver even if a screwdriver even works for that particular gun.

claims.label: Host Says Bagley Testified to Reaching the Roof at 12:44 and Finding Screwdriver in Gravel
claims.claim: The host says Bagley testifies he reached Losi at 12:44 and discovered the screwdriver 10 to 15 feet past the railing in the gravel.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the 12:44 arrival with the 12:47 bystander clip and with the preliminary-hearing transcript.
claims.transcript_snippet: he gets on to Losi building at 12:44. He discovers that screwdriver 10 to 15 ft past the railing in the gravel.

claims.label: Host Says Bagley Went Up After the FBI Had Arrived and Started Securing the Scene
claims.claim: The host says Bagley went onto the Losi rooftop after the feds had arrived and begun securing the scene, so any plainclothes companion would have been up there during the FBI's lockdown.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the scene access log and FBI arrival documents to test who was authorized on the rooftop at 12:44.
claims.transcript_snippet: I want to underscore that officer Baggley went onto Losi rooftop after the feds had arrived and had secured and began securing the scene.

claims.label: Host Says the FBI's Nearest Field Office Is in Salt Lake City, a 50-Minute Drive
claims.claim: The host says the FBI office is actually located in Salt Lake City, a 50-minute drive, which makes a 16-minute arrival remarkably fast.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain FBI office addresses and the dispatch/arrival logs for September 10 to test the 16-minute figure.
claims.transcript_snippet: That is remarkably fast given the FBI um office is actually located in Salt Lake City. That's a 50-minute drive.

claims.label: Host Says the Nearby Provo Office Has Apparently Four Agents
claims.claim: The host says the FBI has a little office in a building in nearby Provo that apparently has four agents.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the Provo FBI resident-agency headcount and location through FBI records or FOIA.
claims.transcript_snippet: They have a little office in a building in Provo nearby that has apparently four agents.

claims.label: Host Says the Bystander Clip Came From Footage Sent to Her on September 10th
claims.claim: The host says she went combing through all the footage that was sent to her on September 10th and found the bystander clip of Bagley's rooftop companion there.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask the host for the original submission, sender and metadata of the 12:47 bystander clip.
claims.transcript_snippet: I went combing through all the footage that was sent to me on September 10th

claims.label: Host Says Robertson Appears Immediately in Charge in Early Footage
claims.claim: The host says that in the early footage Allan Robertson seems to be the person immediately in charge, despite being described as a rookie from another campus.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the early scene footage for Robertson giving directions and compare to the incident command roster.
claims.transcript_snippet: Alan Robertson, as we're going through all that early footage, he actually seems like he's the person that's immediately in charge.

claims.label: Nissi Says Robertson Is Seen Walking Around Texting and Making Calls
claims.claim: In the Nissi analysis the host plays, the narrator says the livestream footage shows the red-hat man walking around texting and making calls, which no other law enforcement officer is seen doing.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the livestream source and review it for the red-hat man's phone use and any other officers' behavior.
claims.transcript_snippet: You see him walking around and texting and making calls.

claims.label: Nissi Says Body Cameras Are Supposed to Last About 10 Hours
claims.claim: In the Nissi analysis, the narrator says Bagley says the battery died, but the camera had run only 27 minutes and these body cameras are supposed to last around 10 hours.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the UVU police body-camera model specifications and the device's battery and docking logs.
claims.transcript_snippet: He says the battery died, but the camera had only been running for 27 minutes and these body cameras are supposed to last around 10 hours.

claims.label: Host Says Robertson Seems to Be Calling the Shots From Farnsworth to Bagley
claims.claim: The host says there seems to be an immediate understanding from Terrell Farnsworth to Officer Bagley that Robertson is calling the shots and is in command of the post-assassination operation.
claims.investigative_direction: Interview officers at the scene about who directed the rooftop response and obtain the command roster.
claims.transcript_snippet: there seems to be an immediate understanding that this Alan Robertson character who shall not be named is calling the shots.

claims.label: Host Says Robertson Was a San Bernardino Police Officer Just Before Utah
claims.claim: The host says Robertson was a police officer in San Bernardino, California just before going to Utah, with a very short stint before he was moved out.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Robertson's San Bernardino PD employment dates through a California public records request.
claims.transcript_snippet: But he was also a police officer just before going to Utah in San Bernardino, California.

claims.label: Host Describes the Brady List as a Prosecutor-Kept Database of Officer Credibility Issues
claims.claim: The host describes the Brady List website as a database of officers with a documented history of misconduct, dishonesty or integrity violations, kept by prosecutors to share with defense attorneys.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify the Brady List website's own description of what its entries mean and who maintains them.
claims.transcript_snippet: it's a uh a database of law enforcement officers who have a documented history of misconduct, dishonesty, or integrity violations.

claims.label: Host Says Not Every Officer Has an Entry on the Brady List
claims.claim: The host says she checked whether there is an entry for every officer in the land and concluded from the site's about section and her own search that there is not.
claims.investigative_direction: Search the Brady List site for officers from other departments to confirm that not all officers are listed.
claims.transcript_snippet: I searched online and said nope that's not what they do.

claims.label: Host Says San Bernardino PD Has a Lot of Corruption
claims.claim: The host says there is a lot of corruption in the San Bernardino, California Police Department, and asks Californians for information about an incident involving Robertson.
claims.investigative_direction: Review public reporting, DOJ findings and court records about San Bernardino PD misconduct.
claims.transcript_snippet: Obviously, you guys also know there's a lot of corruption in the San Bernardino, California Police Department.

claims.label: Host Says Robertson Moved to Utah in August 2024
claims.claim: The host says Robertson decided to go to Utah in August 2024 despite having spent his whole life in California, and calls the timing precise.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain USU hiring and lateral-transfer paperwork showing Robertson's start date and prior employer.
claims.transcript_snippet: he decided to go in August 2024 despite the fact that his entire life has been in California.

claims.label: Host Says It Is Plausible Robertson Was Involved in Something in San Bernardino
claims.claim: The host says it is a plausibility that Allan E. Robertson was involved in something in San Bernardino, noting a habit of transferring officers in trouble to other departments, while saying she is not claiming he was.
claims.investigative_direction: Seek the underlying Brady disclosure or personnel records for Robertson via public-records requests and defense-bar contacts.
claims.transcript_snippet: it is definitely what I would assert is a plausibility uh that Alan E. Robertson was involved in something in San Bernardino.

claims.label: Host Asks for Tips on Robertson at the Tip Line
claims.claim: The host asks viewers who worked with Robertson in San Bernardino, or know why he transferred, to send tips to the more-tips address.
claims.investigative_direction: Review incoming tips about Robertson for named, checkable sources and corroborate before relying on them.
claims.transcript_snippet: please send us tips to more tips at candacewowens. com

claims.label: Host Repeats the Tip Line Address
claims.claim: The host repeats the request to email more tips to the Candace Owens address, joking about her pregnancy brain.
claims.investigative_direction: Not applicable beyond tracking tip volume and follow-up on the Robertson thread.
claims.transcript_snippet: Email us more tips at Candace, sorry, Candace Owens. com.

claims.label: Host Says It Is Plausible Robertson Found the Screwdriver and Is Not Named Because of Brady Issues
claims.claim: The host says it is plausible the person who actually found the screwdriver was Allan Robertson, and that prosecutors would not name him because a Brady List entry would damage his credibility as a witness.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask prosecutors whether Robertson is on any witness list and obtain the chain of custody for who recovered the screwdriver.
claims.transcript_snippet: I think it's plausible that the person who actually found the screwdriver was Alan Robertson.

claims.label: Host Says Her Security Guard Had a Severe Stroke and Brain Surgery
